rick-1.mp3.text: A Rick from another dimension. Don’t trust him, Morty. I wouldn’t.

rick-2.mp3.text: We’re in its hangar, Morty. Every ship’s got a soft middle.

morty-1.mp3.text: Ow! Rick, we hit a rock! A big one!

morty-2.mp3.text: Oh no. Oh no, Rick, it’s a Cromulon!

han-1.mp3.text: Story of my life. Make it count, kid.

han-2.mp3.text: That cannon’s the only reason anyone got off this ice ball.

luke-1.mp3.text: Ben stood here. He left my father on that bank, burning.

luke-2.mp3.text: My mother came here, didn’t she, Artoo? To bring him back.

walt-1.mp3.text: The RV’s back there, Jesse. Don’t make me come get you.

walt-2.mp3.text: That’s our shipment, Jesse. Nobody touches our shipment.

jesse-2.mp3.text: A tiny little escape pod. For a tiny little dude.
